workerResult.summary: Fable Foundry — a steampunk generative fable press. Type (or roll) a moral, pick an alloy temper (Brass/Soot/Aether) and ingot size (Spark/Ingot/Epic), then pull the lever: gauge sweeps, gears spin up, steam puffs and a WebAudio clank play while a seeded engine casts a unique illustrated-in-prose fable (hero, rival, relic, place) revealed typewriter-style on parchment with the moral stamped in brass. Cast fables into brass story ingots persisted in localStorage with re-read/copy/melt/export-all. Fully keyboard-operable (/, Ctrl+Enter, R/T/L/X/S/C, [/], Enter/Del, ?, Esc) with skip links, focus rings and aria-live states. Verified: node --check clean, every JS-referenced id exists in HTML, CSS braces balanced, single-column layout under 640px so no overflow at 375px.
